sources.quote: Con la participación de un solo oferente se efectuaron 42,6 % de todos los procesos de contratación pública adjudicados bajo régimen común de los últimos seis años, en Ecuador.
sources.searcher_note: National data investigation of one-bidder procurement in Ecuador, 2016-2021: 42.6% of all ordinary-regime awards, $6.051B. No breakdown by province or for town-hall works; Los Ríos and Quevedo not named. Measure differs from the lead's.

sources.quote: The proportion of single-bid tenders in open procedures is also trending downward since 2015, decreasing from 29% in 2015 to 20.5% in June 2022.
sources.searcher_note: National trend: single-bid share falling, 2015 to mid-2022. Same measure family (one-bidder share) at a different level and window. No province or municipality detail.

notes: Nothing found names Los Ríos town halls, the 29-of-66 one-bidder count or the Quevedo $6.3M contract. Only national pattern coverage of one-bidder procurement in Ecuador. The two national figures measure different things: CONNECTAS 42.6% covers all ordinary-regime processes 2016-2021; OCP 20.5% covers open procedures to June 2022. Neither can be lined up with the lead's 44% town-hall works share or its 15% coastal comparison. Also seen, not recorded: a 2022 La Barra Espaciadora investigation of $41M in unfinished Quevedo sewer works, 2011-2021 (no bidder counts); an El Universo piece on a Los Ríos provincial-government road dispute; a Contraloría audit of a Los Ríos bioinputs project (not town-hall works). Two more queries were planned but never ran, because the session's WebSearch budget ran out (200 of 200): 'Fundación Ciudadanía y Desarrollo contratación pública municipios Los Ríos único oferente' and a July-Sept 2026 Los Ríos procurement news query. So there's no dedicated recent-coverage query for this story. 9 queries were actually run.
